pages.title: What it does
text: Right-click to refund every invested point while keeping your level and experience.
It is exactly equivalent to /rpg respec and to the button on the screen. It is not consumed when nothing is invested.

pages.title: Crafting
text: Book + gold ingot + ender pearl + paper, shaped.

pages.title: When to use it
text: When you want to switch builds (offense to defense, say) or simply experiment with a stat.
Respeccing is free and has no cooldown, so the only cost is the crafting materials.
